Variants.Content: The Water Gardens are located on the Dornish coast west of Sunspear and were the residence of the Martell family. Daeron II built this place for Queen Melia of Dorne. The courtyard is famous for its pools, fountains, fruit trees and sea breezes. Children of different origins play together in the pool, which has become a symbol often used by Dornish nobles to talk about equality and ruling responsibility.

The water garden is not just the main hall; ship repair wood, canvas, salt, fish catch and stones to resist the sea wind are also shaped here by the common memories of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Water Gardens They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
